column1: # Stage S9 K2a, third of four: the Discord OAuth2, guild-member and webhook clients become api_discord.
# The staging folder becomes the crate's src/ whole and its mod.rs the crate root. The module prefix
# is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder (first: a file two rows of one prefix both reach
# takes the earlier row), one `crate::` row scoped to the API source and one `api::` row scoped
# to the API package (its integration tests and the staging-fixtures binary). Grouped use trees
# were split before the rows ran.
